game_points_iff_played.name: game_points_iff_played
game_points_iff_played.value:
("game"."points_a" is null) = ("game"."points_b" is null)
        and (
          ("game"."status" = 'played' and "game"."points_a" is not null)
          or "game"."status" = 'cancelled'
          or ("game"."status" = 'proposed' and "game"."points_a" is null)
        )

player_identity_state.name: player_identity_state
player_identity_state.value:
(
        not "player"."marked_as_deleted"
        and "player"."anonymized_key" is null
        and btrim("player"."first_name") <> ''
      ) or (
        "player"."marked_as_deleted"
        and "player"."anonymized_key" is not null
        and "player"."first_name" = ''
        and "player"."last_name" = ''
      )
